name: Chha Gosht
instructions: 1. Marinate the mutton pieces with salt, turmeric, and ginger-garlic paste for 30 minutes.
2. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and add cumin seeds, bay leaves, and black cardamom.
3. Add the onion paste and sauté until golden brown.
4. Add the marinated mutton and cook on high heat until browned.
5. Lower the heat, add coriander powder and red chili powder, then slowly pour in the buttermilk while stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
6. Cover and simmer on low heat for 45-60 minutes until the meat is tender and the gravy thickens.
7. Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and fresh coriander before serving with steamed rice.
description: Chha Gosht is a signature dish of the Pahari cuisine of Himachal Pradesh. It is prepared during special occasions and festivals, reflecting the state's reliance on dairy and slow-cooking traditions to tenderize meat in the cold mountainous climate.
